candidate_rule: within one evaluation all six D6 candidates use the same grammar g
endpoint_requirement: every raw history ends at the same declared endpoint packet state and VECTOR_SUM=2d; loops/revisits may increase transition count without changing SEGMENT_PACKET_COUNT
history_identity: source seed identity + vector transition word + declared internal-state branch lineage

microgrammars.name: AFFINE_UV_REPLAY
microgrammars.split_semantics: incidence source supplies three distinct admissible histories; CPBC recoalesces at endpoint

microgrammars.name: SINGLE_SPLIT_RECOALESCE
microgrammars.split_semantics: incidence class chooses canonical or d-loop branch; branches recoalesce before/at endpoint

microgrammars.name: DELAYED_SPLIT_RECOALESCE
microgrammars.split_semantics: incidence split delayed to q-loop boundary

microgrammars.name: TWO_STAGE_SPLIT_RECOALESCE
microgrammars.split_semantics: two independent optional loop decisions create four distinct histories then endpoint recoalescence

microgrammars.name: LAUNCH_CLASS_SPLIT_CONTROL
microgrammars.split_semantics: launch source class branches into two distinct histories; incidence has one

microgrammars.name: VECTOR_INTERNAL_REWRITE_ENDPOINT_EQUIVALENT
microgrammars.split_semantics: two internal-state lineages traverse identical vector word but remain distinct histories until endpoint recoalescence

same_packet_cells_rule: all histories use only the declared continuation packet states P0,P1,P2,P3, with first-visit order 0,1,2,3; optional loops only revisit already-declared states

witness_search_box.construction: choose two candidate labels p<q; A_p,I_p,A_q,I_q each in {0,1,2,3}; all other candidate A,I zero
witness_search_box.purpose: search exact robust, compatible-tie, dependent, all-unresolved classes; no post-result expansion

word_symbol_semantics: d is candidate directed vector; q=rho(d); '-' is additive inverse in Lambda
